The failing command rejects eight T09 runtime/task paths in an actual lifecycle-valid integration merge.

The rejected paths are HavenlineGodot/assets/harvesting_v1/t09_motion_capture.gd, HavenlineGodot/assets/harvesting_v1/t09_motion_fixture.gd, HavenlineGodot/scripts/harvest_presentation.gd, HavenlineGodot/scripts/main.gd, HavenlineGodot/tests/capture_task09_harvesting.gd, HavenlineGodot/tests/test_task09_integration.gd, tools/havenline/task09/motion_capture.py, and tools/havenline/task09/validate_harvesting.py.

The production-governance workflow calls validate_migration_scope.py unconditionally near the start of the job, while its correct lifecycle-aware validate_integration_scope.py call is in a later step that cannot execute after the earlier set -e failure.
FI-T09-003 is not the causal match: its ownership-lag signature predicts integration-scope ownership errors, but the exact integration-scope reproduction has zero errors.
blockers.root_cause: The production-governance workflow routes every triggered commit through the governance-only, base-authoritative migration-scope validator before classifying lifecycle-valid task integration. validate_migration_scope.py intentionally filters all HavenlineGodot runtime ownership and correctly rejects runtime in a governance migration; applying it to an authorized T09 integration commit is a lane-selection error, not an ownership or product defect.
blockers.affected_object: Production-governance workflow orchestration and validator selection for integration-branch events; no shipping product object is disproven.
blockers.causal_fix: Make the early fail-fast scope gate branch/event aware: retain validate_migration.py and the strict validate_migration_scope.py path for governance-only migration work, but use validate_integration_scope.py for actual integration-branch/task-integration changes before downstream governance checks. Add a workflow-routing regression assertion that an authorized task integration is not preempted by the migration-only classifier. Do not broaden migration-scope allowlists.
